name: SendWhatsAppMessageViaMessagingService
label: Send WhatsApp Message via Messaging Service
discription: Sends a WhatsApp message using Twilio Messaging Service.

fields.name: FromNumber
fields.label: From WhatsApp Number
fields.description: The WhatsApp-enabled Twilio number to send from. Format: whatsapp:+14155238886

fields.name: ToNumber
fields.label: To WhatsApp Number
fields.description: The recipient's WhatsApp number. Format: whatsapp:+91xxxxxxxxxx

fields.name: MessagingServiceSid
fields.label: Messaging Service SID
fields.description: The SID of the Twilio Messaging Service to use.

fields.name: MessageBody
fields.label: Message Body
fields.description: The content of the WhatsApp message to send.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result Output
fields.description: Output result: Success or Error message
